pages.text: A focus torn from the space between worlds. It hurls a shard of condensed void that deals a flat amount of damage plus a share of the target's maximum health.$(br2)Because the bolt is made of pure void, not even a boss's damage limit can blunt it.$(br2)Cast through a $(bold)Void Staff$(), the bolt also erodes the target with Void Touched and tears every boon off its body, granting them to the caster - and it bursts on impact, tearing at nearby foes as well.
